export LC_ALL=C
export PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
printf 'SDMON1\000'
part() {
    printf '%s\000' "$1"
    shift
    "$@"
    result=$?
    printf '\000%s_code\000%s\000' "$section" "$result"
}
section=stat; part stat head -c 262145 /proc/stat
section=memory; part memory head -c 65537 /proc/meminfo
section=uptime; part uptime cat /proc/uptime
section=boot; part boot cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
section=load; part load cat /proc/loadavg
section=hostname; part hostname cat /proc/sys/kernel/hostname
section=kernel; part kernel uname -r
section=arch; part arch uname -m
section=os; part os head -c 16385 /etc/os-release
section=cpuinfo; part cpuinfo head -c 65536 /proc/cpuinfo
section=time; part time date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z %Z'
printf 'timezone\000'
if test -r /etc/timezone; then head -c 1024 /etc/timezone
else readlink /etc/localtime
fi
printf '\000'
section=net; part net head -c 65537 /proc/net/dev
section=addresses; part addresses ip -o address show
printf 'indices\000'
for interface in /sys/class/net/*; do
    test -r "$interface/ifindex" || continue
    printf '%s ' "${interface##*/}"
    cat "$interface/ifindex"
done
printf '\000'
section=mounts; part mounts head -c 524289 /proc/self/mountinfo
section=df; part df timeout -s KILL 4 df -P -k -T
exit 0

test "$#" = 4 && test "${#1}" = 36 && test "${#2}" = 64 && test "${#3}" = 64 || exit 65
case "$1" in *[!0-9a-fA-F-]*) exit 65;; esac
case "$2$3" in *[!0-9a-fA-F]*) exit 65;; esac
case "$4" in ''|.|..|*/*|*\\*) exit 65;; esac
case "$4" in *.[tT][aA][rR]) ;; *) exit 65;; esac

umask 077
sd_dir="/tmp/serverdeck-image-$1"; sd_path="$sd_dir/$4"; sd_child=
test -d /tmp && ! test -L /tmp || { echo 'Temporary directory is unavailable or linked' >&2; exit 1; }
mkdir -- "$sd_dir" || exit
cleanup() {
    sd_status=$?
    if test -n "$sd_child"; then
        if kill -0 "$sd_child" 2>/dev/null; then kill -TERM "$sd_child" || sd_status=1; fi
        wait "$sd_child" 2>/dev/null
    fi
    if test -L "$sd_dir" || ! rm -f -- "$sd_path" || ! rmdir -- "$sd_dir"; then
        printf 'Archive cleanup incomplete: %s\n' "$sd_dir" >&2; sd_status=1
    fi
    exit "$sd_status"
}
trap cleanup 0
trap 'exit 1' HUP INT TERM
run_child() { "$@" & sd_child=$!; wait "$sd_child"; sd_result=$?; sd_child=; return "$sd_result"; }
printf 'SD_ARCHIVE_PREPARED:%s\n' "$1"

sd_id="sha256:$2"; sd_reference_hash=$3
sd_references=$(d image inspect --format '{{range .RepoTags}}{{println .}}{{end}}' -- "$sd_id") || exit
set -f
sd_reference=
for sd_candidate in "$sd_id" "${sd_id#sha256:}" $sd_references; do
    sd_hash=$(printf '%s' "$sd_candidate" | sha256sum) || exit
    sd_hash=${sd_hash%% *}
    if test "$sd_hash" = "$sd_reference_hash"; then sd_reference=$sd_candidate; break; fi
done
test -n "$sd_reference" || { echo 'Image reference changed; refresh the image list' >&2; exit 1; }
sd_actual=$(d image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' -- "$sd_reference") || exit
test "$sd_actual" = "$sd_id" || { echo 'Image reference changed; refresh the image list' >&2; exit 1; }
run_child docker --host unix://$sd_socket image save --output "$sd_path" -- "$sd_reference" || exit
sd_actual=$(d image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' -- "$sd_reference") || exit
test "$sd_actual" = "$sd_id" || { echo 'Image reference changed during export' >&2; exit 1; }
sd_archive_hash=$(sha256sum -- "$sd_path") || exit
sd_archive_hash=${sd_archive_hash%% *}
printf 'SD_ARCHIVE_SHA256:%s:%s\n' "$1" "$sd_archive_hash"

printf '\nSD_ARCHIVE_READY:%s\n' "$1"
while :; do run_child sleep 1 || exit; done
